spans.s:
haṃsodakam हंसोदकम्
Water detoxified by exposure to the rays of sun and moon and Canopus star
Water purified by the rays of the sun and moon and detoxified by the effect of Canopus or “cleanser of waters” star (agastyanakṣatra) which is seen in autumn (sharad ṛtu).

ITA-3.13.13 Hanvasthi, hanukāsthi हन्वस्थि, हनुकास्थि
Mandible

.34 hanugrahaḥ हनुग्रहः
Lockjaw; trismus
A disorder characterized by difficulty in chewing; difficulty in speaking; mouth remaining open; lack of pain; mouth remaining closed/trismus.
